title: Geothermal Energy: The Potential of the Subsoil of Île-de-France Revealed
summary: The article discusses the increasing attractiveness of deep geothermal energy as an alternative to rising hydrocarbon prices. This source of energy can heat urban areas by accessing heat from underground waters at depths exceeding 500 meters. The French government has been strongly supporting this initiative, especially since 2023.

title: The Center of Expertise for Heat Pumps Officially Launched
summary: The Centre d'expertise pour les pompes à chaleur (Cepac) was launched on May 20, 2026, aimed at providing reliable information on technical and legislative developments related to heat pumps. This initiative, presented during the Pac day organized by the French association for heat pumps (Afpac), is set to benefit construction professionals. It consolidates support for the evolving market of renewable energy solutions.

title: In Rennes, Urban Restructuring of the Hôtel Dieu District Continues
summary: The restructuring of the Hôtel Dieu site in Rennes involves the rehabilitation of the former hospital and the construction of 415 new housing units. This large-scale urban renovation project is part of the Rennes 2030 initiative aimed at revitalizing the city center and expanding into surrounding areas. The program, which began in January 2021, is set to be completed by 2028.

title: Industrial Hoffmann Green Signs Partnership with Norée Construction
summary: Hoffmann Green, a cement manufacturer, has announced a partnership with Norée Construction. This collaboration aims to innovate and enhance sustainable construction practices. The partnership highlights significant developments within the industry.

title: Energy Saving Certificates (CEE), a Strategic Lever for French Energy Sovereignty
summary: Les Certificats d'Économies d'Énergie (CEE) soutiennent l'efficacité énergétique en France, allégeant les factures des ménages et entreprises tout en promouvant l'électrification des usages. Malgré des critiques, leur financement contribue à réduire les dépenses énergétiques et améliorer la souveraineté industrielle. En fin de compte, les CEE demeurent cruciaux pour réduire la dépendance aux énergies fossiles et bâtir un avenir durable.

title: C'est dans l'actu: The Next Transformation of the Louvre Museum
summary: The Louvre Museum is set for a major transformation, announced by Culture Minister Catherine Pégard, as part of the "Louvre Nouvelle Renaissance" project. The project aims to enhance visitor experience with new entrances and facilities, including a dedicated room for the Mona Lisa. The architectural firms involved include Studios Architecture Paris, Selldorf Architects, and Base Landscape Architecture.

title: Eiffage Strengthens Its Position in the Data Center Market
summary: Eiffage's German subsidiary, Salvia, is expanding its operations in the data center market through a recent acquisition. This move is part of Eiffage's strategy to strengthen its position in energy systems across Europe. The expansion reflects the growing demand for data centers amid increasing digitalization.

title: Sonepar France Welcomes a New Director of Offer
summary: François Courtet has been appointed the new director of Sonepar France's offerings. His role will focus on enhancing the company's product strategy. This transition is a significant move for Sonepar as it aims to strengthen its market presence.

title: This Week's Figures: High Costs for New Housing by 2050
summary: The construction sector continues to face challenges, with significant news emerging over the past week despite the May Day holiday. Key topics include future residential needs by 2050, renovations of the Louvre, and financial trends affecting artisans in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region.

title: At Pessac (33), a Tertiary Building Aims for Well-Being and Environmental Sobriety
summary: À Pessac, un nouvel immeuble tertiaire nommé Inspiratio vise à allier confort des utilisateurs et respect de l'environnement. Ce bâtiment reflète les attentes modernes des entreprises en matière de flexibilité et de performance écologique. Le projet s'inscrit dans une tendance architecturale actuelle qui promeut des espaces de travail durables.

title: The Best Construction Site of France 2026: Two Exceptional Projects Awarded
summary: The 2026 edition of the Best Construction Site competition showcased fourteen exceptional projects to students from ESTP. This initiative, organized by the student association Passion BTP, emphasizes practical learning and engagement in diverse construction fields. Students explored various sites including the Grand Paris express and a new art museum in Massy.

title: Successfully Implementing an Energy Renovation Project
summary: Bail Rénov’ assists property managers, landlords, and tenants in understanding energy renovation and consumption through free services. Advisors provide guidance via remote support and in-person workshops to simplify renovation processes. Their goal is to improve housing performance, sustainability, and comfort for all.

title: In Fos-sur-Mer, the Photovoltaic Panel Gigafactory Will Not Be Built
summary: The planned photovoltaic gigafactory in Fos-sur-Mer, announced by Carbon to strengthen the PV industry, will not be realized. The project, previously slated for development, has been scrapped, canceling plans for 290,000 square meters of infrastructure. This decision reflects ongoing challenges in the implementation of large-scale renewable energy projects.

title: These Ecological Cabins Designed by Students Enchant Schoolyards
summary: L'exposition "Mini Maousse 10 : Super Cabane !" présente des conceptions écologiques de cabanes créées par des étudiants pour repenser l'habitat et favoriser les liens intergénérationnels. Initié par la Cité de l'architecture, le concours encourage l'utilisation de matériaux naturels et recyclés. Cette initiative vise à sensibiliser les enfants à l'écologie à travers un processus ludique.

title: Passoires thermiques and the Rental Market: "We Must Remove Barriers to Work"
summary: Valérie Létard discussed her housing mobilization law proposal in the French National Assembly on May 20, 2026, emphasizing the importance of easing barriers to existing housing solutions. She warned that without developments in unfurnished rentals through the Jeanbrun device, furnished rentals under the LMNP regime would gain traction. The proposal aims to address the ongoing housing crisis.

title: IA: Knowing One's Territory and Target Addresses to Find Upcoming RGE Projects
summary: The article discusses the importance of localized prospecting in the energy renovation sector, highlighting the need for businesses to adopt more respectful and targeted approaches, especially with the decline of unsolicited telemarketing. It emphasizes the role of artificial intelligence in enhancing data-driven targeting, allowing companies to identify the most relevant properties for their services. Ultimately, it advocates for a structured prospecting strategy to improve credibility and effectiveness in customer relations.

title: The Sustainable Building Plan Focuses on a Collective Narrative to Revitalize Renovation
summary: The current climate for building renovation is challenging, with a gradual withdrawal of public aid and relaxed restrictions on the rental of thermal sieves. Prioritization of new construction in housing plans hampers renovation efforts. There's an ongoing need for strategic changes in public renovation policies.

title: Towards a New Decrease in the Primary Energy Coefficient of Electricity?
summary: The article highlights a minor but significant detail in the national electrification plan that may reignite heated discussions come 2025. It suggests that changes to the primary energy coefficient of electricity are anticipated. This change reflects ongoing debates and possible implications for the sector.

title: Dispart Expands Its Expertise in Sanitary Spare Parts
summary: Dispart, a specialized network of Cedeo, is expanding its expertise in spare parts for sanitary heating and climate control systems. The article discusses their initiatives aimed at enhancing service offerings and product availability in this sector. It highlights the importance of this expansion for maintaining competitive edge and meeting market demands.

title: Grand Paris Nord University Hospital: Construction Starts
summary: The construction works for the Grand Paris Nord university campus have officially begun. This project aims to enhance healthcare access in the region, providing a modern infrastructure for hospital and educational services. It represents a significant investment in the future of healthcare in Paris.

title: The Construction Industry Strays Further from the Paris Agreements
summary: A recent report by the UN Environment Programme indicates that the construction sector is moving further away from the Paris Agreement goals for building decarbonization. The findings highlight a significant gap in the industry's progress towards sustainable practices. Urgent actions are required to align the sector with international climate commitments.

title: Gedibois Reaches 60 Points of Sale
summary: Gedibois, launched in 2008 by Gedicoop, continues its expansion across France. It has achieved significant success by reaching 60 points of sale, enhancing its territorial network. The initiative underscores the growing demand for construction and DIY materials in the market.

title: At 22, Activist Amine Kessaci Takes the Lead of Marseille Habitat
summary: Amine Kessaci has been elected as the president of Marseille Habitat on May 19, 2026. His candidacy was proposed by Marseille's mayor, Benoît Payan, and received unanimous support from the board. Kessaci's election marks a significant milestone in his 22-year activism career.

title: Real Estate: Reservations for New Housing Are Not Picking Up in the First Quarter
summary: In the first quarter of 2026, 16,502 new homes were reserved by individuals, reflecting a slight increase of 4% from the previous quarter. Compared to the same period in 2025, the increase is modest at just 0.5%. These figures were published by the Ministry of Urban Affairs and Housing on May 19, 2026.

title: In Toulouse, the Renewal of a Bank's Headquarters Goes Through Circular Architecture
summary: The Caisse d'Épargne Midi-Pyrénées is building a new campus in Toulouse, starting in September 2025 and expected to be completed by the start of the 2027 school year. This project will enhance its existing 7-hectare location in the Lardenne neighborhood, employing 1,900 people in the region. The initiative reflects a commitment to architectural innovation and community development.

title: A Note from the Sustainable Building Plan Invites Making Renovation More Desirable
summary: The Plan bâtiment durable has released a note presenting solutions to expedite the decarbonization of buildings. Authors Alexandra Lebert and Christophe Rodriguez emphasize that relying solely on rational discourse and scientific advantages may have limitations. They call for a broader discussion on the subject.

title: The Jeanbrun Device: "Disappointing in Two Ways"
summary: The article discusses the impact of the PTZ (zero-interest loan) in promoting housing projects that might not materialize without it. It highlights the current restrictions on new individual homes under the Jeanbrun device, which contrasts with previous ambitions outlined in the Cosson report. The need for such financial tools for social and economic inclusion is emphasized.

title: One of the Largest Technicenters in Europe Ready to Enter a New Era
summary: Le projet Villeneuve Demain vise à moderniser le technicentre de Villeneuve-Saint-Georges, l'un des plus grands d'Europe. S'étendant sur 30 hectares, il servira à maintenir et accueillir 125 trains, augmentant ainsi les capacités d'entretien. Ce développement est essentiel pour le RER D et la ligne R du Transilien au sud-est de Paris.

title: In Oise, a Microtunneler Named to Complete a Heat Network
summary: On May 18, 2026, local officials and representatives from the Oise mixed syndicate gathered in Villers-Saint-Paul to inaugurate a microtunneler. This infrastructure project aims to enhance the local network. The event highlights the commitment to improving regional development.

title: A New President for Inoha
summary: David Riquier has been appointed as the new president of Inoha, an association representing manufacturers of maintenance and DIY products. His leadership is expected to influence the industry positively. The announcement signals a new chapter for Inoha amidst evolving market demands.
